info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Violations-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Violation Retrieval API provides access to details of parking reservation violations. This endpoint allows users to list all reported violations related to parking reservations, offering crucial insights for parking enforcement and management. Typical consumers include city officials, parking enforcement officers, and developers integrating violations data into their applications. The API aims to assist in monitoring compliance and improving parking regulations through accessible violation data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of violations associated with reservations. It provides detailed information about each violation, enabling effective management and mitigation of issues related to the reservations.
